title: Membership Desk Cross-Notice: Belrose Circle Standing and the Multiple on an Upgrade Credit
content:
The multiple at which the credit standing is taken, in fixing the least a customer must spend under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes, is lowered for members of the Belrose Circle Membership Programme whose tier and lifetime qualifying spend, as their membership records them, reach the levels below.

## The notice

Where the customer's membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold and their lifetime qualifying spend reaches fifty thousand (50000 USD), the multiple is one and two fifths (1.4). Where their membership stands at Belrose Circle Gold and their lifetime qualifying spend reaches twenty thousand (20000 USD), the multiple is one and three quarters (1.75). Otherwise no such lowering applies and the multiple is the one the programme publishes for an upgrade.

A membership stands above Belrose Circle Gold when its tier is Belrose Circle Platinum, Belrose Circle Black or the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. The lifetime qualifying spend is the figure the membership record carries. Both conditions of a line must hold for that line's multiple to apply.

## Tier and spend together

| Membership tier | Lifetime qualifying spend | Multiple |
|---|---|---|
| Platinum, Black or Founders' Club | 50000 USD or more | 1.4 |
| Platinum, Black or Founders' Club | below 50000 USD | the programme's published multiple |
| Gold | 20000 USD or more | 1.75 |
| Gold | below 20000 USD | the programme's published multiple |
| Silver or Member | any | the programme's published multiple |

## Boundaries

- A Belrose Circle Gold member with a lifetime qualifying spend of exactly 20000 USD reaches the level: the multiple is 1.75. At 19999.99 USD it is the programme's published multiple.
- A Belrose Circle Platinum member with a lifetime qualifying spend of 30000 USD has not reached 50000 USD, and being above Gold does not by itself lower the multiple: the programme's published multiple applies.
